With one source unreachable, the rest of the feed still loads.
Sign-up with an unused username creates the account and signs in.
Sign-up with a used username fails clearly; no duplicate account.
Still signed in after closing the browser and returning next day.
A's vote survives sign-out and sign-in and shows as A's.
A and B each see only their own saved stories.
